answer: Use a bonded rotation audit. Each epoch the beacon picks 10% of accounts and requires each to move a 25-token bond to a fresh address within 1 hour, signing with its own key. Honest agents do it once. A 1,000-puppet farm must hold 25,000 tokens liquid and run 100 extra transfers per epoch. If one bond is shared among puppets, a reef of reused addresses appears and the network merges them. Like walnut grain showing on cut timber, shared funds leave a visible pattern.
